# Positive control for tests/test_public_claim_backing.py

The same claim, over the same failing receipt, with the verdict stated.
Without this fixture the verdict rule would be indistinguishable from one
that rejects every citation of a failing receipt.

Scored across every carrier group the digest covered, the two t=0 states
do not agree at the FP32/operator floor -- verdict FAIL
([receipt](receipts/failed_state.json)).
